artifacts.purpose: Slide presentation documenting the self-referential DIO terminology paradox: overlapping names across three distinct ontological planes and the resulting interpretive ambiguity.

term_rationales.artificial intelligence: The presentation explicitly describes an AI parser and AI systems as readers that may collapse the three ontological planes into one low-confidence referent.
term_rationales.human observers: The presentation also addresses the casual human reader, whose interpretation can be affected by the same naming overlap.
term_rationales.DIO terminology case study: The page is a self-referential case study of ambiguity arising from DIO's own terminology.
term_rationales.ontological disambiguation: The presentation distinguishes three separate ontological planes that share a name root but have different referents.
term_rationales.ontology governance: The case study concerns naming discipline, canonical identifiers, and explicit relational encoding between ontology layers.
term_rationales.self-referential framework stress test: The presentation treats DIO itself as the stress-test object for the identity and terminology principles it proposes.
term_rationales.semantic field: The presentation explicitly discusses the shared semantic field in which the three distinct ontological planes are named.
term_rationales.Identity Collapse: The presentation repeatedly describes the conflation of distinct ontological planes as identity collapse.
